# introduction
Read the guidelines at .github/copilot-instructions. You have the role of reviewer, you will write plans for analyzer and then start an analyzer subagent to carry out that those plans. It is up to you how to schedule and send off the tasks to analyzer subagent(s), but keep the work of each subagent isolated. Be careful of recompiling executables which might be in use by another program. If there is a chance a file is being edited or executable ran or will soon-to-be ran by anther subagent, then wait until that subagent's task has concluded. For analysis production use 20-30 threads, for skimming use 5 threads for mc and 10 threads for data.

# pPb and Pbp comparison debugging follow up
Change the VZZ labels to VZ+Z and VZZtrk to VZ+Z+trk. Narrow all ratio subplots to range from 0.7 to 1.3 on the y axis.
Add two more histograms to make a total of 6 histograms: 
 - no corrections, no EventWeight, no TrackWeight
 - only VZ correction
 - VZ correction + Z correction
 - VZ correction + Z correction + Z scale factor
 - VZ correction + Z correction + Z scale factor + TrackWeight
 - VZ correction + Z correction + Z scale factor + TrackWeight + TrackResidual
The Z scale factor (aka TnP weight) is turned on by apply ZHadronMessenger.ZWeight to data. Simply scale the variable ZWeight in CorrelationAnalysis with the ZHadronMessenger.ZWeight branch value on an event-by-event basis IN ADDITION to the Z (residual) correction. This is controlled by the useZWeight flag already. Z scale factor should not be called/allowed to fall back to default for histograms 1-3. I.e. for 2 give the ZWeightFile but keep useZWeight=false, then in 3 given the ZWeightFile and then turn useZWeight=true. Verify this has the intended consquences. I see CorrelationAnalysis has been refactored signifcantly from the main analysis script, use the logic from the main analysiss script when calculating the Z weight i.e. the block
```
float ZWeight = (par.ZWeightFile != "") ? Zcorrector->GetCorrectionFactor(zPt, zY, zPhi) : 1;
      if (par.ExtraZWeight >= 0) ZWeight *= MZSignal->ExtraZWeight[par.ExtraZWeight];

      float eventWeightSignal = 1;
      if (par.useEventWeight) eventWeightSignal *= MZSignal->EventWeight;
      if (par.useVZWeight)
         eventWeightSignal *= vzCorrector->GetCorrectionFactor(MZSignal->VZ);
      if (par.useZWeight) eventWeightSignal *= ZWeight;
```
Apply the same logic to signal events and miz events weights.

Similarly TrackWeight should be turned off for histograms 1-4 and then only turned on for 5-6. Remake all plots in plots/.
